description:
Rewrite gen_tailscale from scratch in Elixir (separate repo), replacing:
  tailscale_transport → gen_tailscale (Erlang, forked gen_tcp_socket) → libtailscale (C NIF → Go)
with:
  tailscale_transport → gen_tailscale (clean Elixir GenServer) → ts_elixir (Rustler NIF → tailscale-rs)

Two repos:
  1. gen_tailscale (new repo) — gen_tcp-compatible API, GenServer socket/listener, simulation test harness
  2. tailscale_transport (this repo) — ThousandIsland transport (TCP + SSL), Plug

Design principles:
  - Separate I/O from logic via a Transport behaviour (real ts_elixir vs simulator)
  - Deterministic simulation testing: seeded fault injection, controlled scheduling
  - Property-based testing (StreamData) against the simulator
  - ~500-700 lines of production code, emphasis on testability over features
title: Replace gen_tailscale/libtailscale with clean Elixir rewrite on top of ts_elixir
